author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Reads at 48 in both themes as a crescent moon (tilted, horns to the right as in the reference), the chandrabindu dot and cup, and the Om below.
omissions: The moon is a solid-reading crescent (a hollow outline 8 thick cannot fit above the Om); the small tick at the Om waist is omitted; the chandrabindu ring is a dot.
